proposed_capability: P00/P01/P141/P95 and P82/P07/P08 Trifecta: honor observed queue capacity (operator heuristic 2–3 multitasking, 6–7 not multitasking) and plan teen homework only at an attested safe indoor study surface, preferring focus opportunities. Reuse existing room_census/house_state and teen_homework/host_stack/host_listener, not a second lot model or game-input daemon.
player_save_control_impact: Read-only planning, no SendInput, no queue cancellation, no autonomous movement, no new background service, no save or game file mutation. Yield on player direction; unknown scene, room, seat, multitasking, or queue capacity must not authorize an enqueue.
expected_outcome: With inventory homework present, a home-lot snapshot containing an attested indoor furnished study surface is ranked before any homework action; the Sim must be independently observed in that room and seated before a homework enqueue is proposed. Without a credible study space, advise scan/inspect and do not choose sidewalk/floor. Multitasking uses conservative 2 of operator-observed 2–3 and non-multitasking 6 of 6–7; capacity unknown yields no speculative additions. Suppress duplicate homework and preserve player commands.
negative_tests: Queue length exceeds conservative capacity -> no new enqueue
Unknown multitasking -> capacity unknown and hold
Unverified room or outdoor surface -> no study target
Desk without observed chair -> not valid study station
Valid attested desk and chair -> navigate/seat first, never blind homework
Sim at target but not seated -> seat/verify first
Sim seated in matching attested room and queue available -> allow one homework action
Survival and school-premises gates still outrank homework
No new live cert, no agent startup or hidden DAEMON
rollback_path: Revert the bounded feature branch; leave main, local game, saves and certified profiles untouched.
